test_title: PYST 22: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 14 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

She said, "The organisation was established a year ago."

options.text: She said that the organisation was established a year ago.
She told that the organisation was established a year before.
She said that the organisation had been established a year before.
She said that the organisation has been established a year ago.

solution:
The correct answer is **'She said that the organisation had been established a year before.'**
